hooks.command: mkdir -p "$HOME/.caddie/state"; cat > "$HOME/.caddie/state/last-posttooluse-input.json"; { echo "=== $(date -u +%FT%TZ) PostToolUse ==="; echo "PATH=$PATH"; echo "HOME=$HOME"; command -v caddie 2>&1 || echo 'command -v caddie: not found'; "$HOME/.local/bin/caddie" --help >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'absolute caddie: OK' || echo "absolute caddie: FAILED exit=$?"; } >> "$HOME/.caddie/state/hooks-debug.log" 2>&1

mkdir -p "$HOME/.caddie/state"; cat > "$HOME/.caddie/state/last-stop-input.json"; { echo "=== $(date -u +%FT%TZ) Stop ==="; echo "PATH=$PATH"; echo "HOME=$HOME"; command -v caddie 2>&1 || echo 'command -v caddie: not found'; "$HOME/.local/bin/caddie" --help >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo 'absolute caddie: OK' || echo "absolute caddie: FAILED exit=$?"; } >> "$HOME/.caddie/state/hooks-debug.log" 2>&1
